title: Landing page
summary: A full marketing landing page composed from header, hero, logo cloud, features, pricing, testimonials, a closing CTA, and a footer.
brief: Assemble a conversion-focused marketing page top to bottom: sticky-ish header with nav + CTA, a hero, social-proof logos, a feature grid, pricing tiers with one plan highlighted, testimonials, a closing CTA, and a footer. All sections are presentational and read from a single theme — keep colors on semantic tokens so the page restyles with the theme.

sections.intent: Top nav with brand, links, and a primary CTA.
The headline pitch and primary call-to-action.
Social proof — customer or integration logos.
Explain the core product value in a grid.
Plan tiers with one recommended plan highlighted.
Quotes that build trust before the close.
Final conversion push before the footer.
Site navigation, social links, and legal line.

layout: Stack the sections vertically in declared order inside a single page wrapper (no max-width on the page itself — each block manages its own container and padding). Header first, footer last; everything between scrolls. Drop the optional logos/testimonials sections when you lack real content rather than filling them with placeholders. Each section installs as its own file — import a block from `@/components/ui/<section.block>` (e.g. import { MarketingHero } from "@/components/ui/marketing-hero").

checklist.check: [MarketingHeader] Avoid: Passing more than ~5 links — the inline row gets crowded; group secondary items under the CTA or a footer.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Putting raw tags in actions instead of , losing button styling.
[MarketingHeader] Avoid: Forgetting the logo links to '/' — wrap the logo node in an anchor.

[MarketingHeader] A11y: The mobile toggle is a <button> with aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at the panel and an aria-label that flips between 'Open menu' / 'Close menu'. Links are real anchors, keyboard-focusable, with visible focus rings.
[MarketingHero] Avoid: Passing a long paragraph as the title — keep the title to one line; move detail into description.
[MarketingHero] Avoid: Putting raw tags in actions instead of , which loses the button styling and focus ring.
[MarketingHero] Avoid: Using layout='split' with no media — it leaves an empty column; drop to 'centered'.
[MarketingHero] Avoid: Hard-coding colors via className instead of relying on the semantic tokens, which breaks theme switching.

[MarketingHero] A11y: Renders a single <h1> for the page — don't place another <h1> elsewhere. Decorative media should carry an empty alt or aria-hidden. CTA focus rings come from the Button primitive.
[MarketingLogoCloud] Avoid: Forgetting alt text on logo s, so the brand names aren't announced.
[MarketingLogoCloud] Avoid: Omitting the React key on each logo node, causing reconciliation warnings.
[MarketingLogoCloud] Avoid: Passing huge images — the grid caps height at ~2.5rem; export trimmed logos.

[MarketingLogoCloud] A11y: Logos are images — each needs an alt of the brand name. The caption is a plain

, not a heading, so it doesn't disrupt heading order.
[MarketingFeatureGrid] Avoid: Passing an as an icon — the icon well is sized for a glyph (size-5); use an SVG icon, not a photo.
[MarketingFeatureGrid] Avoid: Writing a paragraph in each description — keep cells scannable, one or two sentences.
[MarketingFeatureGrid] Avoid: Setting columns='three' with only two features, leaving a gap — match columns to the count.

[MarketingFeatureGrid] A11y: Each cell title renders as an <h3> under the section <h2>, preserving heading order. Decorative icons are presentational; if an icon conveys meaning, give it an accessible label.
[MarketingPricing] Avoid: Highlighting more than one tier — the emphasis is meant to steer toward a single recommended plan.
[MarketingPricing] Avoid: Giving the highlighted tier a generic CTA label like 'Choose' — name the plan ('Choose Pro') for screen readers and analytics.
[MarketingPricing] Avoid: Passing plain text as cta instead of a <Button> — you lose the full-width styling and focus ring.

[MarketingPricing] A11y: Each tier name renders as an <h3> under the section <h2>. Feature check glyphs are aria-hidden; the feature text conveys meaning. Give generic CTAs an aria-label naming the plan.
[MarketingTestimonial] Avoid: Using 'grid' layout with a single testimonial — leaves a lopsided row; use 'single'.
[MarketingTestimonial] Avoid: Putting the author name inside the quote text instead of authorName, which breaks the figure/figcaption structure.
[MarketingTestimonial] Avoid: Avatars with no empty alt — decorative avatars should have alt="" since the name is already in text.

[MarketingTestimonial] A11y: Each testimonial is a <figure> with the attribution in <figcaption>, so the quote and its author are programmatically associated. Avatars are decorative (the name is text) and should carry empty alt.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: On variant='panel', passing a primary <Button> — it disappears against the primary background; use variant='secondary' or 'outline'.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: Omitting actions entirely — a CTA with no button is just a heading.
[MarketingCta] Avoid: Stacking multiple panel CTAs, creating competing focal points.
[MarketingCta] A11y: Renders an <h2>, keeping it below the hero's <h1>. On variant='panel', button contrast must clear WCAG against the primary fill — prefer secondary/outline buttons.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: One column with 20 links instead of a few grouped columns — group by topic.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Omitting the copyright line, which most footers are expected to carry.
[MarketingFooter] Avoid: Putting social icons with no accessible label — wrap each in a link with an aria-label or sr-only text.

[MarketingFooter] A11y: Each column title renders as an <h3>. Links are real anchors with visible hover/focus states. Social icon links need an accessible name (aria-label or sr-only text) since the icon alone isn't announced.
